subject: automatic directory index with a per-user server configuration

messages.author: 726815e70c374c3d
messages.subject: automatic directory index with a per-user server configuration
parts:
Is it possible to configure shiny server to use automatic directory indexing with a per-user server set-up?  I've tried the following shiny-server.conf settings without success.

server {
  listen 3838;

  # Define a location at the base URL
  location / {
    user_apps;
    
    directory_index on;
  }
}

messages.author: 68ce5dd269fd758c

messages.subject: Re: automatic directory index with a per-user server configuration
parts:
In the next release of Shiny Server (which we think will be "1.2.0", user_apps and user_dirs will now respect the directory_index setting. So the configuration you mentioned above will work as of the pending release.

It should be out in the next week or two.

Jeff
